additional_info.body:
Hi Florent, good afternoon.
No, the Cable is ok, I checked remotely and we had a communication failure with the SECC until the reboot was performed.
It seems that since 1 month ago, there has been no errors of this sort, this was the only instance so far.
I will report to our development team that the reported error is not correct (Cable Theft) and needs to be fixed.
Since this is the first occurrence, please keep monitoring and if this error reoccurs, please raise a new ticket with this ID0481193 number attached so that we can process the regional field service team for a site visit.
I will proceed to close the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
